tagline: The capital where old temples, high-rises, and street food share the same soi
introHtml:
Bangkok can change its face in a matter of minutes. Walk out of Wat Phra Kaew by the Chao Phraya River, ride the BTS a few stops, and you hit big malls and skyscrapers in the heart of Siam. Come evening there are night markets and rice-and-curry shops down the sois to graze through.

People visiting Bangkok tend to pack a lot into one day — temples, markets, cafes, and rooftop bars — because the food and sights sit close together and link up easily by skytrain and boat.
bestTime: November–February, cooler than the rest of the year with little rain — comfortable for walking around outdoors

highlights.name: Rattanakosin Island
highlights.blurb: The old quarter by the Chao Phraya, with Wat Phra Kaew, the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun all close together — easily a full day of walking

highlights.name: Yaowarat
highlights.blurb: Chinatown that turns into a long stretch of street food by night, with Chinese eats, grilled seafood, and old-school shops

highlights.name: Siam–Ratchaprasong
highlights.blurb: The heart of the shopping district, taking in Siam Paragon, CentralWorld, and the Erawan Shrine, all linked by skywalk

highlights.name: Charoenkrung–Talat Noi
highlights.blurb: An old riverside neighborhood that has become a hub of cafes, galleries, and street art, mixing old buildings with new shops

highlights.name: Thonglor–Ekkamai
highlights.blurb: The restaurant, cafe, and bar district of younger Bangkok, from laid-back spots to places that get busy after dark

highlights.name: Chatuchak
highlights.blurb: A huge weekend market selling just about everything — clothes, plants, home decor, and food

foodScene.name: Yaowarat street food
foodScene.note: The city's most famous night-time food street, with noodles, fried oyster omelette (hoi tod), grilled seafood, and Chinese sweets

foodScene.name: Khao gaeng (rice and curry)
foodScene.note: Rice-and-curry shops sit on every soi across the city — ladle several dishes over a single plate of rice; it's the working lunch of choice

foodScene.name: Boat noodles and noodle shops
foodScene.note: From rich boat noodles (kuaytiao ruea) out toward Rangsit to little shops tucked in alleys downtown — easy to find all day

foodScene.name: Every region's food in one place
foodScene.note: Bangkok has it all — Northern, Isan, Southern, and seafood — as people from every region move in and open shops

foodScene.name: Cafes and coffee shops
foodScene.note: Charoenkrung, Ari, and Thonglor are full of well-designed cafes and specialty coffee shops

foodScene.name: Floating markets and night markets
foodScene.note: From Taling Chan Floating Market to the night markets, plenty of food and bits to browse and snack on in the evening

foodScene.name: Moo kratha and buffets
foodScene.note: Moo kratha (DIY grill-and-hotpot) and grill buffets are everywhere — the dinner where groups of friends meet up

foodScene.name: Famous spots and rooftops
foodScene.note: From Michelin places in old alleys to rooftop bars with river views — something for every budget and occasion

attractions.name: Wat Phra Kaew and the Grand Palace
attractions.blurb: The heart of the old city by the Chao Phraya, home to the Emerald Buddha and some beautiful Thai architecture

attractions.name: Wat Arun
attractions.blurb: The riverside prang covered in porcelain tiles, looking great from across the water at Tha Tien by day or night

attractions.name: Wat Pho
attractions.blurb: An old temple with a giant Reclining Buddha and the home of traditional Thai massage, right next to the Grand Palace

attractions.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
attractions.blurb: A huge weekend market with thousands of stalls — you can shop your way through it from morning till evening

attractions.name: Siam and Ratchaprasong
attractions.blurb: The big-mall district downtown, linked by skywalk and BTS, with the Erawan Shrine close by

attractions.name: Chao Phraya river cruise
attractions.blurb: Take an express boat or cross-river ferry for views of the river, passing temples, old buildings, and bridges through the city

attractions.name: Lumphini Park
attractions.blurb: A big park in the middle of the city with a lake, running track, and shady trees where locals come to exercise

attractions.name: Bang Krachao
attractions.blurb: A green, bulb-shaped pocket on the Chao Phraya over on the Samut Prakan side — cycle through the gardens and floating market

itineraryIdeas: Bangkok cafe trail — Charoenkrung, Ari, Thonglor
Bangkok for nature — Lumphini Park and Bang Krachao
Bangkok for markets and street food
Bangkok–Samut Prakan–Samut Songkhram — floating markets and the sea
Bangkok–Ayutthaya — a day in the old capital
